description: Indoor routine filmed with the Mac's camera (Photo Booth, mirrored, 30 fps): calibration, knee lifts, jumping jacks, walking, squats, ready position, shadow tennis strokes.
reported_by: windows set by hand from video frames every 2 s (2026-10-19)
window_source: Times are seconds after Start. No trial markers were pressed; video time = Start time + 18.17 s (video/alignment.json). Windows are accurate to about 1 s.

video.notes: A second person sits at the left edge of the frame; mask the left third for motion-based alignment and crop it out before sharing any frames.

activities.name: walking
activities.note: Across the frame and back, partly side-on.

activities.name: squats
activities.note: Three deep squats (knee ~100° in video and IMU); looked like sitting in 2 s frames.

activities.name: ready_position
activities.note: Hands together at the chest, as when holding a racket.

activities.name: out_of_frame
activities.note: Too close to the camera: Vision pose unreliable.

activities.name: shadow_strokes
activities.note: Forehand and backhand shadow swings, often side-on.
